summary: Iteration 10 — security-fix verification: 20/20 pytest cases pass on the public backend URL. Verified SEC-001 (admin login returns token, token authorizes /entitlements + /admin/overview; forged Bearer token = 401 on both; regular-user token = 403 on admin routes), login brute-force lockout (5 wrong attempts on a throwaway email all 401 with generic 'Email or password is incorrect'; correct password during lock window ALSO 401; unlocked accounts still log in), password-reset OTP hardening (forgot-password returns {status:sent} for both unknown + known emails, wrong OTP = 400, 5 wrong attempts lock the code and a 6th attempt with any code still returns 400 — code single-use rate-limit works), CSV formula-injection neutralization (seeded retailer_click with barcode '=DANGER()' and '-SUM(A1)' → export CSV prefixes both with single quote; no naked =/- cell openings), and regressions (products/lookup for barcode 8901030895001 returns the seeded 'Organic Rolled Oats' product, public /launch-offer active=true with free_days≥1, admin GET+PUT /admin/launch-offer work, /admin/analytics/overview returns totals+daily+top_products+retailers, new user registers with current legal versions and /entitlements shows trial_active=true with 365 trial_days_remaining). Admin account was NOT locked out — lockout tests used throwaway veriscan-lock-*@example.com emails.
critical_code_review_comments: core/config.py:17-24 — JWT_SECRET fail-fast is correct: <32 bytes OR a known-weak literal aborts boot. Confirmed backend/.env sets a strong value and the app is running.

routes/auth.py:29 — DUMMY_HASH generated at import time equalizes bcrypt timing for unknown emails; combined with generic 'Email or password is incorrect' this closes the enumeration + timing side-channel.

routes/auth.py:38-43 — lockout resets `failures` to 0 when setting `locked_until`; that's fine (the check keys on locked_until first) but means each subsequent wrong attempt after unlock only starts a fresh window at attempt 1. Acceptable per spec.

routes/auth.py:148-153 — atomic find_one_and_update with `attempts:{$lt:5}` correctly locks the OTP after 5 wrong tries (returns None → 400). Single-use is guaranteed via `used:{$ne:true}` filter + delete_many on success.

routes/analytics.py:101-106 — _csv_safe neutralizes leading = + - @ \t \r. Only user-controllable free-form cells are `key` (always prefixed with a literal like 'barcode:' so safe), `category`, `retailer_id`, `barcode`. All are wrapped in _csv_safe in analytics_export. Good.
server.py:39 — CORSMiddleware allow_credentials=False and allow_origins=['*']. Correct (credentials + wildcard is disallowed by browsers anyway).
routes/admin.py:35 — re.escape(q.lower()) properly neutralizes regex metachars in the admin user search (ReDoS + regex injection safe).
seed_data_creation: Test-scoped ephemeral users: veriscan-lock-<hex>@example.com (login lockout test), veriscan-otp-<hex>@example.com (OTP lockout test), veriscan-trial-<hex>@example.com (trial verification); analytics counters for retailer_click barcode='=DANGER()' + '-SUM(A1)' seeded via /api/analytics/track for CSV sanitization test. Admin account left untouched (no lockouts, no email/phone changes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All security fixes verified end-to-end against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_10_security.py is safe to re-run — uses uuid-suffixed throwaway emails and never touches the admin account. Note two selector adjustments I made after the first run: (1) /products/lookup requires an X-Guest-Id header for anonymous callers (pre-existing contract, unrelated to security fix); (2) the CSV sanitization test must use event=retailer_click (not scan) because scan events store the barcode inside the composite `key` field ('barcode:<val>') which starts with a safe letter — only retailer_click stores `barcode` as a standalone column that the CSV writer emits raw, which is the actual formula-injection surface.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 5 security fixes (JWT fail-fast, login lockout + constant-time bcrypt, bcrypt-hashed single-use rate-limited OTP, CSV sanitization, escaped admin user-search regex) behave exactly as specified. Regression suite (products lookup, launch offer, admin analytics, registration + entitlements trial) also passes.
